campaign: WP-E01-U/V/W Stage V experimental incremental Newton
owner_authorization: Isolated, bounded small-model Hencky Newton research prototype; never connected to public production solver routes.

global_adapter.scope: Previously bounded sparse experimental total-Lagrangian Hencky TET4/HEX8 assembly; no public solver dispatch.

newton_driver.scope: In-memory incremental dead-load Newton prototype with sparse reduced solve, optional residual-merit backtracking, bounded iterations/DOFs, and transactional accepted displacement/load state; no history variables, persistence or public route.

mathematical_contract.reference_configuration: X and Grad_X; x=X+u; F=I+Grad_X(u); energy and PK1 forces are total-Lagrangian.
mathematical_contract.residual: R(u,lambda)=f_int(u)-lambda*f_dead for displacement-independent dead nodal loads only.
mathematical_contract.tangent: K_t=dR/du from the experimental Hencky global assembler, including material and geometric terms.
mathematical_contract.reduced_newton: K_ff delta_u_f=-R_f with selector reduction; prescribed components of delta_u are exactly zero and prescribed displacements are reimposed for each trial.
mathematical_contract.globalization: Optional backtracking on phi=0.5*||R_f||^2; for fixed dead loads and exact Newton direction Dphi=-||R_f||^2. This is not total-potential decrease or a production Armijo certificate.
mathematical_contract.accepted_state: Mesh fingerprint, immutable bytes-backed displacement vector and load factor only. Every supplied state is reassembled and its current free residual is checked against abs tolerance plus relative tolerance times current applied free dead-load norm.
mathematical_contract.reactions: Support-on-structure reactions are recovered from the full unreduced residual; force/moment closure is a consistency check.
mathematical_contract.units: coordinates/displacements m, stress Pa, energy J, force N, stiffness N/m.

verification_cases: TET4 and HEX8 proportional prescribed-displacement affine uniaxial equilibrium over four dead-load increments; independent diagonal PK1 and hand-integrated area reference.
Final-state invariance under two admissible load partitions for TET4 and HEX8.
Small-strain approach to the analytical linear Hencky limit.
Unattainable large load preserves the previous accepted state.
A second increment that inverts TET4 is refused and rolls back to the prior accepted state.
Iteration limit and singular reduced tangent fail closed.
Residual-merit helper checks a synthetic rejected full step and accepted half step; not a physical FEM line-search trajectory.
Invalid trial backtracking, wrong mesh identity, same-mesh prescribed-consistent non-equilibrium state, bounded load schedule, free-DOF embedding, and initial free-equilibrium check.
State scale metadata cannot be caller-inflated; accepted displacement and dead-load arrays cannot have writeability re-enabled.

numerical_diagnostics.convergence_criteria: PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED; absolute force tolerance 1e-8 N and relative factor 1e-9 against applied free dead-load norm.

execution_policy.collection: exact allowlist under fixed-target supervisor; RUN only after accepted collection receipt and second frozen-source preflight.
execution_policy.run: one exact module execution under Windows Job Object; no retries.
limitations: one free mechanical DOF for the principal equilibrium references
physical Newton line-search rejection is not demonstrated; only scalar merit-helper behavior is tested
no incremental material history for path-independent hyperelasticity
no follower loads, contact, instability, or branch tracking
no public solver, native backend, Gmsh, network, worker or external solver
